name: disable_input_suppression

stack.evidence: func_001D8408 takes no Script context, clears D_002B9660, and does not access the value stack

notes: D_002B9660 gates func_00114480's controller-state clearing path. Clearing it stops that path from zeroing the synthesized controller masks. In the JP corpus, 167 calls restore ordinary event/gameplay state and commonly follow commands 112 show_party_status_ui and 114 enable_player_control. This is the inverse of command 418 enable_input_suppression.
